provenance.encodes: FCC document numbering (FCC NN-NNN Commission items; DA NN-NNNN bureau items); Bluebook R. 14.3
provenance.how_to_verify: Open an FCC Record order caption and Bluebook R. 14.3; check that FCC/DA numbers are cited as `FCC 23-45` and `DA 22-1234`.

positive.text: See Report and Order, FCC 23-45, para. 12 (2023).
The Bureau acted by order, DA 22-1234 (rel. Nov. 1, 2022).
The Commission's order (FCC No. 24-52) remains in force.

negative: The FCC voted 3-2 on the item.
The DA filed charges in 22 counties.
